propositions: A guard script must scan the repository for deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary (full phrase and bare SC/SCs tokens) with case-insensitive matching while excluding archives, experiments, vendor bundles, and cache directories.
The guard must enforce an allowlist file mapping file paths to exact expected occurrence counts, failing on count drift, malformed entries, duplicates, and absent paths.

Live prose in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria wording, while permanent carve-outs (experiment language, definition-of-done concept, migration tooling, and test probes) remain allowlisted at pinned counts.
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target so both local make lint and CI run the same check deterministically.

Bare tokens SC/SCs are forbidden repository-wide except under explicitly scoped paths (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md).
Four O-RAN-SC references in ADRs and workflows must remain byte-identical to a prior commit baseline and must not trigger the bare-token rule.
